summary: An AI teacher that lives next to your cursor on Windows. Sees your screen, talks back, points at where to click. Drop a manual into the knowledge folder and Clicky learns the app, even your company's internal tools. 1st runner-up, PyCon Singapore 2026 Hackathon.
